title: design-parity checks config
description: Committed, per-repo a11y + i18n check configuration (`design-parity.checks.json`), read deterministically by the bot at run time. Bootstrap (`@design-parity/baseline`) materializes a starter file; omitted knobs fall back to committed defaults. See docs/PRINCIPLES.md, Principles 1 and 2.

contrastLevel.description: WCAG conformance level the contrast check fails below. 'AA' emits an error under AA and an info between AA and AAA; 'AAA' emits an error under AAA.

minTouchTarget.description: Minimum touch-target size in dp. Defaults to the committed threshold when omitted.

glyphAdvance.description: Average glyph advance as a fraction of font size, used for text-width estimation. Defaults to the committed threshold when omitted.

themes.description: Themes to evaluate. Defaults to those the candidate exposes when omitted.

flagHardcodedStrings.description: Flag every user-facing literal as a possible un-keyed string. Off by default: a render alone can't prove a string came from a resource, so this is an opt-in lint, not a steady-state gate.
